Name: TreeLife
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
Replaces static trees with interactive ones- without replacing maps! I've been working on many mods lately, unfortunately I've run into some problems with ALL that need sorted out before I can proceed any further with releases. This is just a portion of what was going to be included in the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/762?]Cleaning Crew[/url] mod, however since there continually seem to be issues in creating the new update I've decided to cut it down a bit by splitting off into organized 'add ons'. You'll be able to cut down trees across the valley that regrow as intended. As other mods are released, this resource will be updated for compatibility with those mods as well. Currently this mod includes the Town, the Farm, the BusStop and the Forest. Some of these trees are inaccessible without the upcoming mods so this release should be more than enough to do what it says it does. [s]Requires [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-advanced-location-loader.3619/]Advanced Location Loader[/url] & [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url][/s]. 

[b][UPDATE] 05/27/21 - [/b]It's been nearly five years but I've come back for you! New version for use with [b]Content Patcher[/b]. I've removed a lot of code from the old version which you wouldn't even notice but I plan to add it back once I open up these places in other mods of mine which are also incredibly outdated.

[b][UPDATE] 01/25/17 - [/b]New update includes more trees-cutting goodness as well as some pixel fixes. To ensure you have the latest version or to post a question with the fastest response time, please refer to the [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/treelife.127748/]official thread[/url]! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tGXiVnl.gif[/img]

Not available from stardewmods.com OR stardewvalleymods.net.
